.²2 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Identification of two things ({#prakfta#} and {#aprakfta#})
 in such a manner that the one is completely absorbed into the other; {#nigIryADyavasAnaM#}
 {#tu prakftasya pareRa yat#} <ls>K. P. 10</ls>; on such identification is founded
 the figure called {#atiSayokti#}, and the {#lakzaRA#} called {#sADyavasAnA#}. See <ls>K. P. 2</ls>.
